- [ASSISTANT_SAID] To calculate the product of cell E2 and G2, and then add it to the product of cell K2 and M2 in Google Sheets, you can use the formula: `=E2*G2+K2*M2`
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The formula will multiply the values in cells E2 and G2, then add the product of cells K2 and M2 to that result, giving you the final value.
- [USER] User inquired about Google Cloud Speech-to-Text pricing.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Google Cloud Speech-to-Text pricing is based on the number of audio minutes processed by the service.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There are two pricing models available: Standard and Advanced.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] For the Standard model, the pricing is $0.006 per 15 seconds of audio processed, with no minimum fees or upfront commitments, and a free usage limit of 60 minutes per month.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] For the Advanced model, the pricing is $0.012 per 15 seconds of audio processed, with a minimum monthly commitment of $1,000, and a free usage limit of 5,000 minutes per month.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There may be additional charges for features such as speaker diarization, punctuation, and enhanced models.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] There is a free trial available for Google Cloud Speech-to-Text, which provides $300 in credits for a 90-day period.
